study_role: Matched top-3 context restriction and content-preserving 120/30 word rechunking, with top-5 reference
constraints: Use the frozen d1 seed 202609252 source corpus and sentinel identities; no outcome-driven resampling
Preserve the frozen q0 and failure-repair suites, owner-side profiles and six owner groups
Top-3 is the exact prefix of the archived top-5 ranking; do not recompute tie membership with a different top-k selection implementation
Rechunk all ordinary and sentinel source documents uniformly; preserve exact short-document text and all source words
Remove redundant overlap-only trailing chunks; keep source identity distinct from physical chunk identity
Count one evidence observation per sentinel, not per retrieved chunk
Re-index the entire rechunked corpus; no label masking or surrogate retrieval-only success
Do not combine the new index changes with compression, partial transfer or expansion
Use the same three baseline identity permutations across scenarios, retrievers and target models
Use the frozen primary decision and scheduling bounds; report matched clean controls and sensitivity without retuning the primary bound
Collect all 30 answers per group; reuse only exact model, arguments and prompt matches
Share one in-process request cache and limiter across parallel experiment groups
Never turn request failures into negative answers; preserve errors and resumable incomplete groups
No manuscript edits, new baseline or recent private-fact pilot
